mapper.sql: id, session_id, status, total_score, dimension_scores_json, hiring_recommendation, scoring_rule_version, strengths_json, weaknesses_json, follow_up_findings_json, project_mastery_json, knowledge_gaps_json, study_suggestions_json, failure_reason, retry_count, generated_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_report( session_id, status, total_score, dimension_scores_json, hiring_recommendation, strengths_json, weaknesses_json, follow_up_findings_json, project_mastery_json, knowledge_gaps_json, study_suggestions_json, failure_reason, retry_count, generated_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES( #{sessionId}, #{status}, #{totalScore}, #{dimensionScoresJson}, #{hiringRecommendation}, #{strengthsJson}, #{weaknessesJson}, #{followUpFindingsJson}, #{projectMasteryJson}, #{knowledgeGapsJson}, #{studySuggestionsJson}, #{failureReason}, #{retryCount}, #{generatedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_report SET status = 'REPORT_FAILED', failure_reason = #{failureReason}, retry_count = retry_count + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'REPORT_PENDING'
UPDATE interview_report SET status = 'REPORT_PENDING', failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'REPORT_FAILED'

UPDATE interview_report SET status = 'REPORT_READY', total_score = #{totalScore}, dimension_scores_json = #{dimensionScoresJson}, hiring_recommendation = #{hiringRecommendation}, scoring_rule_version = #{scoringRuleVersion}, strengths_json = #{strengthsJson}, weaknesses_json = #{weaknessesJson}, follow_up_findings_json = #{followUpFindingsJson}, project_mastery_json = #{projectMasteryJson}, knowledge_gaps_json = #{knowledgeGapsJson}, study_suggestions_json = #{studySuggestionsJson}, failure_reason = NULL, generated_at = #{generatedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'REPORT_PENDING'
mapper.sql: r.id AS report_id, r.session_id, s.title AS session_title, s.topic_mode, s.form, s.round, s.target_role, s.target_experience_band, s.interviewer_id, s.interviewer_name_snapshot AS interviewer_name, s.status AS session_status, s.ai_model_snapshot, s.ended_at, s.scheduled_at, r.status AS report_status, r.total_score, r.dimension_scores_json, r.hiring_recommendation, r.scoring_rule_version, r.failure_reason, r.retry_count, r.generated_at, r.created_at
r.strengths_json, r.weaknesses_json, r.follow_up_findings_json, r.project_mastery_json, r.knowledge_gaps_json, r.study_suggestions_json
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM interview_report r JOIN interview_session s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY COALESCE(r.generated_at, r.updated_at) DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interview_report r JOIN interview_session s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT r.scoring_rule_version AS ruleVersion, COUNT(*) AS sampleCount FROM interview_report r JOIN interview_session s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'REPORT_READY' AND r.scoring_rule_version IS NOT NULL
AND r.generated_at >= DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
GROUP BY r.scoring_rule_version ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(r.generated_at) DESC
SELECT , FROM interview_report r JOIN interview_session s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND r.id = #{reportId}

SELECT t.session_id AS sessionId, t.answer_source AS answerSource, COUNT(*) AS itemCount FROM interview_turn t WHERE t.session_id = #{sessionId} AND t.answer_source IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.session_id, t.answer_source ORDER BY t.answer_source
